from cyhole import DexScreener

# Initialize DexScreener client (no API key required)
dex = DexScreener()

# SPL token mint address (example: USDC on Solana)
mint_address = "EPjFWaJY5yca6bB2BqCD8jhBQu6pFPvdB4xKbHrZqBg"

# Retrieve all trading pairs for this token on Solana
pairs = dex.get_pairs(chain="solana", token_address=mint_address)

# Print the number of pairs
print(f"Number of pairs: {len(pairs)}")
